item.title: Apple releases iOS 26.3 beta 3 for iPhone
item.description: Apple has released iOS 26.3 beta 3 for iPhone. iOS 26.3 introduces an easier way to switch between Android and iPhone, tweaks to the Astronomy and Weather wallpaper gallery, and more. more…

item.title: macOS Tahoe 26.3 beta 3 rolling out now for developers
item.description: After releasing iOS 26.2.1 for iPhone earlier today, the company is now rolling out macOS 26.3 beta 3 for developers. Here’s what to expect. more…

item.title: Apple releases beta 3 for iPadOS 26.3, tvOS 26.3, more

item.title: Apple releases third RCs for macOS Sequoia 15.7.4 and macOS Sonoma 14.8.4

item.title: iOS 26.3 adds new feature to limit location data shared with your carrier
item.description: In a new support document today, Apple details a new iOS 26.3 feature exclusive to devices with an Apple modem: “limit precise location.” Apple explains that this setting allows you to “limit some information that cellular networks may use to determine your location.” more…

item.title: Apple expands iPhone share in India as overall smartphone market shipments flatten
item.description: As reported by TechCrunch, Apple’s iPhone shipment share in India rose to a record 9% in 2025, according to Counterpoint Research data. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Apple TV adds Richard Gere to upcoming limited series with Jessica Chastain and Ben Stiller
item.description: As reported by Deadline, Gere will join Chastain and Stiller on “The Off Weeks”, an eight-part limited series to be directed by Michael Showalter (The Dropout). Here are the details. more…

item.title: AirTag 2: Three tidbits you might have missed
